payload.title: The AI persona module gate checks the tenant-role capability ai_specialties:<module> instead of module membership, and auth-service seeds ai_specialties:farm as granted on every default role including Viewer, so every tenant member can drive the farm specialist and its farm-data tools
evidence: libs/shared-contracts/src/ai/persona-catalogue.ts:257 (a specialty's requiresModule becomes the RBAC capability ai_specialties:<module>)
apps/ai-service/src/agent/agent-profile.service.ts:202 (the persona gate is hasAllResourcePermissions over that capability list)

apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-role.service.ts:297 (the Viewer role is seeded with ai_specialties farm: true; so are Supervisor :148, Technician :176, Feed Manager :206 and Operator :250)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/permission-catalogue.ts:131 (ai_specialties is a role permission resource, not a module grant)
apps/messaging-service/src/channel/resolvers/channel.resolver.ts:201 (AI channel creation applies the same capability check)
payload.rule_violated: D4 (ai is module-scoped) and D2: a persona that requires a module must require the caller's grant in that module.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-12, release R5.
